title: ChEBI, Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (CORE)
notes: Archived release 254, ontology versionIRI http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/chebi/254/chebi_core.owl, artifact dated 2026-08-14. CORE retains definitions and hierarchy but omits FULL's synonyms and manually curated cross-references; LITE omits definitions and is unsuitable for grounding. License confirmed in the artifact's dcterms:license and the archive's ontology/LICENSE, with publisher guidance at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/about. Asserted hierarchy only: full ChEBI reasoning is not part of this pin. Entity IRIs are preserved, including those also described in PMDco.
